control.title: You decide what to study
control.text: No questions are written until you approve the topics. Uncheck what you already know, rename a topic, edit its subtopics, or describe bigger changes in plain words.

gaps.title: Practice that finds your gaps
gaps.text: Every round asks all of the topic's questions: the ones you haven't answered first, then the ones you got wrong last time. Your effort goes where it matters most.

questions.first: What should a good meeting agenda include?
questions.second: How do you choose between two urgent tasks?
questions.third: Tell about a time you handled a disagreement

tutor.title: A tutor for every question
tutor.text: After each answer you see the right option at once. Not sure why it's right? Ask the AI tutor and go as deep as you need.
tutor.question: A customer is upset about a late delivery. What do you do first?
tutor.answer: People listen to reasons once they feel heard. Acknowledge the problem first, then explain and offer a fix.

proof.title: Know when you're ready
proof.text: Each topic has a progress bar towards its certificate. Earn it, and the topic counts as mastered.

quality.title: Questions that get better on their own
quality.text: Every question has one correct option and three plausible wrong ones. Votes, reports and answers point out weak questions, and a verifier fixes or replaces them in the background.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Can't find your answer? Write to us at the address in the privacy policy.

different.q: How is prepza different from flashcards or question banks?
different.a: Prepza writes the questions for exactly what you're preparing for, from your job description or goal. Every round starts with what you haven't answered, then what you got wrong; an AI tutor explains every answer; and certificates show when a topic is mastered.

topics.a: Job interviews in any field, certifications, exams, tests, a promotion, or anything you want to learn. If you can describe it, prepza can build a kit for it.

certificates.a: Each topic has its own certificate. Answer every question of the topic with enough of them right, and it's yours. Your latest answer to each question counts, so you can keep practicing until you get there.

cost.a: You pay as you go with credits. A new kit costs {kit} credits, and every new account gets {welcome} free credits, enough for a first kit. The pricing page lists every price.

expire.a: No. Credits never expire, and there are no subscriptions or renewals.

failed.a: You're only charged when a kit is ready. If generation fails or you cancel it, the credits come back to you.

refunds.a: Yes, for credits you bought in the last 14 days and haven't spent: through Paddle, or by writing to us. Free credits, such as the welcome gift, aren't refunded. The terms have the details.

privacy.q: What happens to what I paste and answer?
privacy.a: We use it to build your kits and track your progress. Private kits are visible only to you and the people you share them with. The privacy policy explains what we keep, for how long, and your rights.

delete.a: Yes, in Settings. Your account and your data are deleted, and you can download a copy of your data first.

languages.a: {count} languages, for the site, the kits and the emails. Choose the language a kit is generated in, whatever language your text is in.

hiring.q: How does hiring with prepza work?
hiring.a: Create a company, generate an interview from a job description, and invite candidates by email. Each candidate costs {candidate} credits, charged only when they finish the interview, and a new company gets {company} free credits.

scorecards.a: Every answer, whether it was right and how long it took. They also flag answers too fast to have been read, times the candidate left the page, and copy attempts.

candidates.a: What to expect before they start, then one timed question at a time. They never see their score or whether an answer was right.
